# ScanQR Global

> ScanQR Global (https://scanqrglobal.ai) is the real-time social radar, live venue map, and proximity nightlife platform designed for guests, digital nomads, and nightlife explorers worldwide.

ScanQR Global unites live venue vitals, real-time crowd pulse gauges, zero-friction encrypted QR badges, private radar knocks, and 8-language real-time translation under one privacy-centric platform.

---

## 1. Quick Access & Platform Features

- **Master Portal**: [https://scanqrglobal.ai](https://scanqrglobal.ai)
- **Live Proximity Radar**: Real-time nightlife proximity map without sharing phone numbers.
- **Private Encrypted QR Badges**: Instant mutual connections with Ghost Mode privacy.
- **Real-Time Nightlife Hubs**: Live telemetry across Bogotá, Bangkok, Rio de Janeiro, and Miami.
- **Discretion Guaranteed**: No paper trails, encrypted peer radar, zero cellular charges on Wi-Fi.

---

## 2. Platform Architecture & Privacy

- **ScanQR Global (`scanqrglobal.ai`)**: The autonomous platform for real-time nightlife discovery and proximity networking.
- **Encrypted Radar Knocks**: Spot someone intriguing nearby and send a discreet knock. Mutual intrigue opens a direct line instantly with zero contact details exposed.
- **Ghost Mode**: Vanish from the proximity radar with a single tap while continuing to explore live room vitals and crowd feeds.
- **Live Room Flips**: 10-second unedited live video clips from trending rooms tonight.
- **Multilingual AI Translation**: Two-way real-time voice, video, and text translation running live in-feed.
